task.old_meaning: Low-confidence item needing human review (triage request)
task.migration: No data migration needed — 0 existing records on any tenant

task.meaning: Execution primitive — atomic unit of work with owner, tier, skill reference, lifecycle

skill.meaning: Reasoning methodology — plain English files teaching AI how to approach work

key_decisions.rationale: Current 'task' is a passive triage request. Real tasks are execution units. Clean semantic split.

key_decisions.decision: Skills are vault content, not code
key_decisions.rationale: NTP-OS pattern — skills teach methodology, data carries specifics. Editable in Obsidian, no deployment needed.
key_decisions.chosen: Markdown files in vault skill/ folder

key_decisions.decision: Task Runner as separate Temporal workflow
key_decisions.rationale: Clean separation from EventProcessor. Different concerns: EP classifies, TR executes. Different failure modes and timeouts.
NTP-OS pattern — match AI capability to work complexity. Tier 1 is cheap/fast, Tier 3 is expensive/powerful. Avoids burning expensive models on simple tasks.
key_decisions.chosen: 3 tiers with configurable model per tier

key_decisions.rationale: Core execution loop (phases 1-5) must be stable before adding cascading effects. Propagation without guardrails can create runaway task loops.
